what: At the border between two sections, four or five horizontal bands in the front section’s color (15vh per row) cover the top of the section below, then fold up one by one starting from the bottom band (scaleY 1→0, pivot at top) as you scroll, revealing the lower section like raising a blind. Each band is delayed by .08, scrub 1 (follows 1s behind). On PC it starts when the element’s top edge is at 70% of the screen and ends when its bottom edge is at 80%, on phones (under 768) it starts at the very bottom of the screen and ends with the bottom edge at 75%. Past halfway, data-state changes to revealed

options.rows: Number of bands (created when there are no band children), default 4
options.mode: If grow, reversed — the band unfolds downward and covers
options.start / end: PC ScrollTrigger start · end, default ‹top 70%› · ‹bottom 80%› (original compact is ‹top 60%› · ‹top 20%›)
options.bp: Width that splits PC and phone (px), default 768
options.--fx-h / --fx-color: Band height and color (css variables) — default 15vh · background color
options.look: With rise, the panel (parent) height is divided by the number of band rows and the bottom is the axis — used with mode: grow, the bands grow from the bottom and cover as the head photo leaves the top of the screen
